tools.name: discover
tools.description: Find out what this server can do. With no arguments: every op by category with a one-line intent, plus saved recipes. With query: the best-matching ops and recipes. With op: that op's full contract and examples.

tools.name: invoke
tools.description: Run one operation and get its result as a handle: type, size, estimated tokens, the value itself if small (else a preview), and suggested next ops. Example: invoke(op="fetch", args={"url": "https://example.com"}), then invoke(op="html_to_text", input="<handle from that result>").

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Chain operations in one call; only the final result comes back, intermediate data stays on the server. Example steps: [{"op": "fetch", "args": {"url": "https://example.com/pricing"}, "as": "page"}, {"op": "extract_tables", "input": "$page", "args": {"index": 0}}, {"op": "to_markdown", "input": "$1"}

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Look at a handle: its summary, its value one page at a time, or its provenance. Check est_tokens in the summary before reading a big value; it's usually cheaper to narrow it with an op first (find, select, filter, fit).

tools.name: run_recipe
tools.description: Run a saved pipeline in one call. Built-ins: page_to_markdown (url, max_tokens), page_outline (url), page_links (url, contains), page_tables (url, index), find_on_page (url, pattern).

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.description: Save a working pipeline under a name so any agent can run it later with run_recipe. Saved recipes are shared and can't be overwritten.
